formal_verdict: Complete measured simulation comparison; see scores, not hardware proof

gr00t_n16.failure_rate_note: Task failure = 1 - full closed-loop success. Fall/drop may overlap; timeout is residual and exclusive with both (not success, not fell, not dropped). Other diagnostic reasons may overlap and must not be summed. Zero ground-drop flags does not imply zero handling errors.

scope: Simulation only,5physicalpositions x4seed repeats; not20 independent scenes. Historical original T2 source30s proximity score is not a long-distance5m or released-stable success score.

timing_definitions.task_wall: Trace row0 to qualified stability endpoint for successes; failures retain episode endpoint diagnostically. Includes render/PNG/physics/inference pauses after frame0.
timing_definitions.cold_inference: Model-reported tick0 compute; loading measured separately and may overlap first RPC wait.
timing_definitions.warm_inference: Model-reported inference_seconds at controltick>0; primary inference compute speed.
timing_definitions.RPC_pause: Wall wait for entire policy RPC, includes IPC/preprocessing and tick0 model readiness.
timing_definitions.execution_wall_excluding_RPC_pause: Task wall minus RPC pauses before endpoint, still includes physics/render/recording, not a hardware1x claim.
timing_definitions.process_wall: cold process start to evidence finalized includes startup/cleanup inside simulator, not host Docker launch wall.

adapter_comparison: Both Pi policies require identical norm path and runtime command except checkpoint weights; GR00T uses native50tick decoder. Same actual initial state/interface required per case.
noncausal_interpretation: Validation-selected training and closed-loop task scores are distinct; this summary does not attribute changes to individual recipe components.
